items.followUp: Write down two disadvantages of friction.

rubric.why: Identifies that friction provides grip for safe movement.
rubric.description: Friction between our feet and the ground enables us to walk without slipping.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that friction enables walking or prevents slipping.

rubric.description: Friction between a pen or pencil and paper enables us to write.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that friction enables writing.

modelAnswer: Friction between our feet and the ground enables us to walk without slipping.
Friction between a pen or pencil and paper enables us to write.
